xmldoc.short_description: Gets the value of persistent preferences.

param_input_item.param_description: a character vector or scalar string: the group name. It must be a valid variable name.
a character vector or scalar string: one preference name, or a cell array of character vectors or a string array: several preference names. Each name must be a valid variable name.
any value used when the preference does not exist. With several names, a cell array with one default value for each name.

param_output_item.param_description: a struct with one field for each group. Each field is a struct with one field for each preference of that group.
a struct with one field for each preference of group, or an empty double [] when the group does not exist.
a cell array with the same size as pref, holding the value of each preference.

description.p: s = getpref() returns all the stored preferences, organized by group. It returns a struct without fields when no preference is stored.
g = getpref(group) returns all the preferences of group in a struct, one field for each preference. It returns an empty double [] (no error) when the group does not exist.

value = getpref(group, pref) returns the value of the preference pref in group. An error is raised when the group or the preference does not exist. When pref holds several names, the values are returned in a cell array with the same size as pref.

value = getpref(group, pref, default) returns the stored value when the preference exists. Otherwise the preference is created with default as value (the group is created too if needed) and default is returned. With several names, default must be a cell array with one value for each name, and only the missing preferences are created.
Preferences are read from the file preferences.nh5 of the preferences directory (see prefdir).

example_item.example_item_description: Read preferences, with and without default values, then remove the group.
